capabilities: Link local .lark.md notes to existing Lark/Feishu documents or Bases by URL
Open linked Lark/Feishu documents and Bases in an embedded WebView
Create remote Lark/Feishu documents or Bases from Obsidian commands
Sync remote document titles to local filenames
Browse linked documents in a generated Lark Documents.base view
disambiguation: Not a wiki builder inside Obsidian; .lark.md notes are thin proxies to remote Lark/Feishu documents, whose content stays in the cloud.
extras: Desktop-only because it uses WebView; supports English and Simplified Chinese UI; background title sync is off by default; the README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian notes and Lark/Feishu cloud documents live in separate places, with no way to open or manage the remote documents from inside the vault.
summary: Integration that links local .lark.md proxy notes to Lark/Feishu documents and Bases and opens them in an embedded WebView.
